Our Story

From the
Mountains
of Colombia

The Ramírez family has cultivated coffee since 1966 on their private farm in the Colombian highlands. Every bean is single-origin — grown at altitude on ancestral land, harvested by hand, and shipped directly to Ridgewood. No middlemen. No compromises.

Three times a week we roast in-house. What you taste today was alive days ago.

Crafted Menu

Specialty Offerings

— 01

Espresso Bombón

Double espresso layered over Colombian condensed milk. Sweet, bold, unapologetic. A glass of pure tradition.

From $5

Signature
— 02

El Campesino

Iced cold brew with house-made spiced syrup. A cult classic — the drink regulars return for every single morning.

From $6

— 03

Matcha Latte

Ceremonial grade matcha with silky oat milk. A clean, elevated alternative for the discerning morning ritual.

From $6

— 04

Panela Lemonade

Fresh lemonade sweetened with raw Colombian cane sugar — Panela. Refreshing, authentic, unlike anything else.

From $5

— 05

Pan de Bono

Traditional Colombian cheese bread. Warm, chewy, gluten-free, baked in-house each morning. Pairs with everything.

From $4

GF
— 06

Tres Leches

House-made Colombian tres leches — dense, soaked, impossibly soft. Our most beloved dessert and a Ridgewood institution.

From $7

The Journey

Seed to Cup

01
🌱

Farm Grown

Cultivated at altitude on the Ramírez family estate in Colombia's premier growing region. Handpicked at peak ripeness.

02
🚢

Direct Import

No intermediaries. Beans travel direct from our farm to Ridgewood — full traceability from field to your hands.

03
🔥

Fresh Roasted

Roasted in-house three times per week. Small, intentional batches. Maximum freshness, never compromised.

04
☕

Your Cup

Brewed to order with intention. Every cup carries 58 years of family knowledge and Colombian mountain terroir.
